name: Count Dooku's Type B escort shuttle
wookieepedia_title: Count Dooku's Type B escort shuttle
description: Around 21 BBY, Count Dooku used a Type B escort shuttle to escape from the Theed Royal Palace on the planet Naboo after dueling Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker.
